::: {.atlas-intro}
The map shows where structural vacancy is concentrated and which places have the fiscal and rail capacity to respond. It covers the 1,059 municipal units in the 2023 Housing and Land Survey. The 682 towns and villages below the survey threshold are not mapped.
:::

<h2>Coverage</h2>
<p>1,059 municipal units are mapped. The 682 towns and villages below the 2023 survey threshold are not. The initial view shows the main islands; pan south for Okinawa and other island municipalities.</p>
<p>The 23 special wards have no municipal fiscal-strength index. Station density counts heavy-rail stations only; tram stops are excluded.</p>
